name: One More Thing.
description: A short line about what your show is about.
about: Just two guys, talking about the crazy world of technology that we live in. Hosted by Munro and Thomas, two people who want to hopefully further your technological understanding, skill, efficiency and ability. This podcast discusses topics like tech news, how technology works and a bit of tech history(sometimes).
